metadata.title: Alessandro Amella | Full Stack Developer & CS Student in Aarhus
metadata.description: Full-stack developer from Modena, Italy, now based in Aarhus, Denmark, where I am studying for my MSc in Computer Science. Building web applications, backends and APIs mainly with the MERN stack. AI/LLM integrations, cloud and automation.

homepage.description:
Full-stack developer from Modena, now in Aarhus , where I am studying for my MSc in Computer Science (AI specialisation) at Aarhus University.

I've helped startups and companies, as a freelancer, design and develop web applications, mobile apps and software, from architecture definition to production deployment.

I work mainly in the JavaScript ecosystem (MERN stack), but also handle AI and LLM integrations, cloud infrastructure, process automation and data management. More about me and my projects below!

seta.description:

  • Training of a machine learning model for passenger counting using onboard cameras.

fertec.description:

  • Development of cost analysis software and a Flutter app to interface with medical devices.

freelance.description: Working with startups on various web projects. Mostly MERN stack (or often PostgreSQL and NestJS). I've worked on microservices architectures with automated CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure deployment, and plenty of AI / LLM service integration.

sciopero.title: Web Scraping & LLMs
sciopero.description: Bachelor's thesis and empirical case study on LLM-based information extraction. An LLM pipeline reads unstructured Italian public-transport strike notices and pulls out structured data, such as dates, scope and guaranteed service windows. I ran 1,400+ benchmarks across GPT, Gemini, Llama and DeepSeek with several preprocessing strategies and a resilience test, reaching an F1-score above 0.95 on field extraction.

bamboosim.title: BambooSIM
bamboosim.description: Live commercial travel-eSIM store. After checkout the backend provisions the data plan automatically against the carrier's eSIM API and returns a working profile and QR code in seconds, handling top-ups and plan extensions on the same flow. Multi-gateway payments (card, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay) in local currencies, plus a custom CMS for catalogue, orders and customers.

qrami.title: Telemedicine Platform
qrami.description: Booking and clinical-workflow platform for an Italian health-tech startup, run as a SaaS on Stripe Connect. PostGIS geofenced matching between patients and doctors, multi-stage escalation with timed fallbacks on BullMQ, and Redis locks against concurrent accepts.

iotdashboard.title: IoT Dashboard
iotdashboard.description: Industrial dashboard for monitoring and controlling fleets of IoT sensors. Time-series ingestion and querying on TimescaleDB hypertables with SQL Continuous Aggregates, keeping dashboards responsive over long time ranges. Eclipse Kapua handles device management and telemetry.

ianus.title: Janus
ianus.description: Double-entry accounting engine for Italian VAT-registered freelancers: invoicing, VAT, payment schedules, cash flow and depreciation. The whole system is driven from a chat interface: an LLM layer with function calling and structured output turns plain-language requests into accounting operations, with RAG over the user's own documents.

vhfesuperiori.title: VHF e superiori
vhfesuperiori.description: Event platform and social network for an Italian amateur-radio association, in production and open source. It parses uploaded ADIF/EDI contact logs, geolocates Maidenhead grid squares and renders QSO maps server-side using Puppeteer. It also generates personalised eQSL cards from templates and batches them into daily digest emails to stay within provider quotas. TypeScript monorepo with Express, MongoDB and a React front end.

ezaffitto.title: ezaffitto
ezaffitto.description: Microservice pipeline that scrapes rental listings from several sources and normalises unstructured ad text into a queryable schema with OpenAI extraction. Node.js and Python services orchestrated with Docker.
